description: Prepare supplying collateral to a Midnight market directly on Midnight. First call `morpho_midnight_get_market` for the collateral index and token. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

amount.description: Collateral token amount to supply, in human-readable decimals

collateralIndex.description: Index of the collateral in the market `collaterals` list

marketId.description: Midnight market ID (`market_id` from the Midnight read tools)

userAddress.description: Account that sends the transactions and owns the position

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_supply_collateral
